articles.title: 'We Were Working on a Great Game' — Former Mass Effect 5 Writers Speak Out After EA Shuts Down BioWare
articles.summary: Former writers for the now-canceled Mass Effect 5 are speaking out on social media following news that BioWare, a beloved studio with more than 30 years of games under its belt, was shuttered by EA earlier today.
body: EA announced the news somewhat unceremoniously in a single paragraph tucked within a lengthy open letter on October 21, 2026. “As we focus on these larger opportunities, we've had a small team at BioWare working on early-development for Mass Effect. We've made the decision not to move forward with this development, which means we’re closing the studio and our Edmonton workspace. BioWare is a legendary studio that helped define the role-playing genre, and we do not take this decision lightly,” the statement reads.

It’s safe to say that gamers were gutted by this announcement — as were the staff impacted by the closure, as we’ve now seen several writers who worked on Mass Effect 5 begin to discuss the situation online.

On Twitter/X, New York Times bestselling author Catherynne M. Valente responded to a post wherein a user said, “A game industry that cannot figure out how to make a sequel to the literal best game of all time is a game industry that is fundamentally broken,” speaking on the BioWare closure.
points: Former writers for the now-canceled Mass Effect 5 are speaking out on social media following news that BioWare, a beloved studio with more than 30 years of games under its belt, was shuttered by EA…

articles.title: Star Wars: Battlefront 3 reportedly being co-developed by Battlefield studio DICE and Apex Legends studio Respawn
articles.summary: A new Star Wars: Battlefront game is reportedly in the works, and it's said to have Apex Legends and Star Wars Jedi studio Respawn working on it, as well as Battlefield and Battlefront developer DICE.
body: The information comes from "multiple sources" on Variety, and arrives in the wake of EA's sudden decision to lay off 400 workers, close iconic role-playing game studio BioWare, and cancel several projects. As part of a memo to staff, EA executives confirmed that Respawn and DICE are collaborating on a new project, but stopped short of saying what it was.

The report follows days of murmurings from different sources that a third Battlefront game is in the works. It started with a rumour from Electronic Gaming Monthly magazine (via Giant Bomb ), which said Disney had been on the lookout for a studio to develop Battlefront 3. The names of potential teams included DICE, and Destiny and Marathon developer Bungie.
Wardogs studio head Joe Brammer then responded to the rumour on X, saying it was actually DICE and Respawn working together on Battlefront 3 - information that now appears to be true.
points: A new Star Wars: Battlefront game is reportedly in the works, and it's said to have Apex Legends and Star Wars Jedi studio Respawn working on it, as well as Battlefield and Battlefront developer DICE.

articles.title: ‘Avatar: Seven Havens’ Producer Drops a Huge Clue About Korra and the Cataclysm
articles.summary: Every Avatar inherits the problems of their predecessor. That’s not altogether surprising, since each Avatar spends their life wielding all four elements to bring peace to the world and shaping it according to their own unique vision, then dying… only to be reincarnated into somebody else.
body: Wan, the original Avatar, established the spiritual status quo that would last for the next 10,000 years. After Wan permanently fused with Raava, the spirit of light, he imprisoned the spirit of darkness, Vaatu, within the Tree of Time. He then closed the spirit portals at the North and South Poles, separating humans and spirits, and assumed responsibility for serving as the bridge between their worlds. He died with humanity still at war with itself, and we don’t know how many incarnations it took to bring peace.

In The Last Airbender, we also see this dynamic play out between Avatar Roku and Aang. Roku’s failure to stop Fire Lord Sozin enabled the Hundred Year War, which Aang eventually ended. Aang, in turn, helped establish Republic City as a multicultural experiment, leaving Korra to contend with its political instability and rapid technological growth.
points: Every Avatar inherits the problems of their predecessor.

articles.title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 Narrows Release Window Following Player Feedback
articles.summary: Bandai Namco announced a narrower release window for the upcoming multiplayer-enabled brawler Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3, although it's not too much more specific. Previously, the publisher had stated that the sequel to 2016 fan-favorite would arrive in 2027.
body: "Today we shared more information about battle customization and PvE missions," producer Masayuki Hirano said. "I wanted to use this opportunity to deliver a message to our fans. Over the past several months, we have continuously revealed new information to all of you and, in return, have received valuable feedback. We are truly grateful for that support. Based on the feedback and survey results we have gathered, we have already held discussions with the development team and announced certain areas where we intend to make improvements in response.

"Dragon Ball Xenoverse is a series that we build together with the players through launch, and throughout its post launch life as well," he continued. "To fully realize our ambitions for both the launch experience and the content we plan to operate and support afterward, the release window is currently set for the latter half of 2027." He concluded by suggesting that the team might stay quiet for a while now, saying, "We may keep you waiting a little longer until our next update, but we are fully committed to making 2027 a great year for Dragon Ball game fans, and we will do everything we can to make that happen."
points: Bandai Namco announced a narrower release window for the upcoming multiplayer-enabled brawler Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3, although it's not too much more specific.

articles.title: Brandon Sanderson Wants to Know Who Really Wrote the Mr. Beast Book
articles.summary: Brandon Sanderson, author of The Cosmere books, has some thoughts on the new Mr. Beast book. More specifically, he is wondering who the true author actually is. During the latest episode of his podcast, Intentionally Blank, he decided to dive into his own perception of The Most Dangerous Games.
body: "I'm really curious who the ghost writer was," said Sanderson. "I would love for them to be credited, but I can see why they're not." He then goes on to explain how he personally goes about co-authoring books, which he recently did with Blightfall, and how he thinks that differs from being an editor. His final point on the matter was "if you see someone else's name on a book, chances are I came up with the outline and then was the editor on it."

For anyone who has followed Mr. Beast's YouTube career, it seems pretty unlikely that he did any of the writing himself. The fact that James Patterson is also listed on the book would make it seem the famous author is likely the one who did all of the heavy lifting to get this story off the ground. But Sanderson questions just how involved Patterson actually was in this project and if the true author is maybe left uncredited.

"Normally it's James Patterson and somebody," explains Sanderson, "what happens in those situations usually is James Patterson has an idea, they brainstorm and outline together, then the person writes the book and Patterson reads it and offers feedback."
points: Brandon Sanderson, author of The Cosmere books, has some thoughts on the new Mr. Beast book.

articles.title: Cooler Master HAF II 500 review
articles.summary: Jacob earned his first byline writing for his own tech blog, before graduating to breaking things professionally at PCGamesN, where he was one half of a popular weekly YouTube show.
body: I first spotted the HAF II 500 at Cooler Master's HQ in Taiwan. It wasn't the case that first caught my eye then, it was the massive fan on a stand in front of it. A spinning goliath measuring a mighty 220 mm, of which there are not one, but two stuffed in the front of the HAF II 500.

If you want more airflow over your core components—you got it. The HAF II is more wind tunnel than computer chassis. Those large fans drive an immense amount of airflow over the motherboard, GPU, VRM and anything else caught in their backdraft. It reminds me of the Havn BF 360 in many ways—another PC case that focuses on airflow, albeit with 180 mm fans—right down to the scoop in the front to keep cool air flowing towards the graphics card. They're similarly wide, too.

The HAF II 500 is not just a big beast. It's got the brawn and the brains. There's a space-saving fan hub smartly integrated into the rear of the case, alongside ample cable management options. The front includes a couple ways to keep your build looking tidy, too, including a dual-GPU support bracket and sliding cable management cover.

articles.title: GTA 6's Fast Food Restaurant, Burger Shot, Is Coming to Real Life in the Miami Heat's Arena
articles.summary: One of the most iconic fast food restaurants from the GTA universe is becoming real ahead of GTA 6's release. Rockstar Games' takeover of Miami is continuing to expand with a real-life version of Burger Shot, a famous fast-food restaurant in the GTA franchise.
body: It's unclear if the actual menu will be themed after the in-game restaurant, but it's sort of hard to imagine it will be. In GTA, Burger Shot pokes fun at fast food joints like McDonald's and Burger King for their extremely unhealthy meals. In the game, Burger Shot has menu items like "The Heartstopper," which features seven patties stacked high between a variety of toppings.

It seems more likely that this is all purely decorative, but still, it's a fun touch. Additionally, leaks have indicated that Rockstar is also planning to sell some of the beer brands available in GTA 6 at bars in Miami. It's unclear if they will be available in retail stores or online for fans outside of Florida.

Rockstar Games has other ambitious plans for the Kaseya Center, including an unprecdented regular season game where the Miami Heat will turn into the Vice City heat for one night on November 18. The team will be given new jerseys and play on a GTA 6-themed court.

articles.title: All party members in Final Fantasy Resonance
articles.summary: Meeting new party members in Final Fantasy Resonance is part of the journey. As in other games in the series, you start with only a few characters who team up to go on an adventure, but as they progress, they make friends who join the group.
body: To help you navigate this adventure and locate the new allies you need to save the world, we prepared this guide to explain where to find all party members in Final Fantasy Resonance.

In Final Fantasy Resonance, there are eight party members that you recruit by completing the segment of the main story where you meet them. This means that they are locked behind the campaign, leaving you no alternative but to focus on completing the chapters to add new characters to your roster.

Each character belongs to a specific role, which helps you balance support and offense within your party. At the same time, using the right Vision and mastery bonus skills allows you to complement a character's kit. Shifting them to a different role is quite difficult, though, because a character's stat progression is pre-determined, they will inevitably perform better in certain roles. For example, magic attack is Sakura's highest attribute, making her a natural caster.
points: Meeting new party members in Final Fantasy Resonance is part of the journey.

articles.title: All unlockable Visions in Final Fantasy Resonance
articles.summary: Visions in Final Fantasy Resonance are the material form of memories of heroes, either from the world where the story takes place or from other dimensions. While most of them are protagonists from other Final Fantasy games, there are a few original characters in the roster as well.
body: To help you, we've put together this guide explaining how to unlock all Visions in Final Fantasy Resonance, as well as a list with the most important information about each unit.

Visions in Final Fantasy Resonance work as unique sets of skills that you can equip to complement a character's skill set. At the same time, each Vision belongs to one of the five different roles available in the game — sentinel, commando, breaker, saboteur, and medic — which influence their skill sets and what characters they synergize best with. A character can equip only one Vision, but you can change them whenever you want while outside of battle.

Since they are not playable characters, Visions don't have their own turns in battles. You can use their skills by selecting the Vision's tab in the battle menu. To upgrade a Vision's skills, you must awaken them using one of the three types of magicite: magicite shards, magicite, and magicite crysts.

articles.title: EA is shutting down RPG veteran Bioware "to align talent and investments where we see the greatest opportunities for players and long-term growth"
articles.summary: Venerable RPG studio Bioware announced on it is shutting down after more than 30 years of making RPGs. The studio is responsible for making the original Baldur's Gate, Neverwinter Nights, Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, Dragon Age, Mass Effect, and Anthem.
body: As part of the announcement Bioware also say that "development on the next Mass Effect project is ending."

The post gives no reasoning for the shut down, nor does it mention its parent company EA who made the decision. In an open letter from EA's Chief Operating Officer David Tinson and Chief Studios Officer Cam Weber explained the closure, saying "we’re making deliberate choices to align talent and investments where we see the greatest opportunities for players and long-term growth."
They also cancelled a project in The Sims series code-named project Lotus, prioritising instead another called Project Evergreen.

The letter also revealed that there will be continued investment in EA's sports games, Apex Legends, Battlefield, and the next Star Wars Jedi game. Apparently, Dice and Respawn are collaborating on a new game which is likely a new Star Wars: Battlefront game.

After getting the airship at the start of Chapter 5, you'll be able to fully explore the map. Head to the Chamber of Arms, a small temple north of Dirnado and east of Gronoa.

articles.title: Star Wars Battlefront 3 Reportedly In Development By EA’s Top Shooter Studios
articles.summary: Included in the shocking news of EA's restructuring, which includes layoffs and the closure of BioWare, is a mention from the publisher that Apex Legends studio Respawn Entertainment and Battlefield maker DICE are collaborating on a project.
body: Per Variety, which cites "multiple sources," the DICE and Respawn project is Star Wars Battlefront 3. While EA itself did not confirm this, the company's memo about the restructuring says that the studios' title will contribute to EA's goal of delivering a "shooter portfolio that unlocks growth."

EA specifically states that learnings from Battlefield 6's launch and live service will further that goal, while also announcing that Apex Legends will be expanded with new "gameplay modes" and "other new experiences."

As for the purported existence of Star Wars Battlefront 3, the timing coincides with a recent rumor that Lucasfilm Games was seeking a development partner for a new Battlefront, and that DICE and Sony-owned studio Bungie were among the studios being considered.

DICE had made two Star Wars Battlefront games for EA, which were released in 2015 and 2017. Battlefront 2 attracted criticism over loot boxes (remember when that was the hot controversy of the day?), but the game still proved to be massively popular. Last year, Battlefront 2 suddenly had a resurgence in players, with many hoping that it would ignite talks of a third Battlefront.

articles.title: The next Mass Effect would have had 'a level of autonomy and choice that no other game has been able to match', according to BioWare veteran
articles.summary: A developer working on Mass Effect 4 has spoken up about BioWare's plans for the now-canceled RPG. Tony de Waal was cinematic supervisor at the now shuttered studio. He joined the team "29+ years ago", left for a spell shortly after the launch of Mass Effect 2, and then returned in 2021 to work on…
body: "I was one of the lucky ones who stayed with BioWare to start on the next Mass Effect [after The Veilguard], where I believe we were making something special: a level of autonomy and choice that no other game has been able to match," de Waal wrote on LinkedIn.
"We saw what Larian and CD Projekt were bringing to the table with their latest offerings, and started down a path to bring Mass Effect to the next level while remaining true to the Trilogy."

De Waal also described some of the challenges BioWare faced during the development of The Veilguard, which was the studio's second project made using EA and DICE's Frostbite engine. "It was a herculean effort that tested the limits of even my workaholic mindset, and I'm proud of the level of polish we were able to pull off in the Frostbite engine.

"Seriously, you have no idea the craziness going on under the hood of that game to make a variable player character work across 3+ hours of cinematics, and the number of conditions to account for in the scenes towards the end of the game."

articles.title: EA Cancels New Mass Effect, Pauses New Sims Game, And All The Other Big EA News That Just Happened
articles.summary: When EA was acquired by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, many expected major changes at the gaming company, including layoffs and game cancellations, among other shakeups.
body: EA also teased some of what's to come in the future, including a joint project between Respawn and DICE. Here's a rundown of all the big EA news today.

EA said in a statement that it made the "difficult" choice to lay off staff, and Bloomberg reported that the cuts will impact about 400 people. Affected staffers will be treated with "care and respect," EA said, and some impacted employees may have a chance to get a different job within EA. Alongside the BioWare closure noted below, staff at Ripple Effect (Battlefield), Maxis (The Sims), and Full Circle (Skate) have been impacted, as noted by Vertical Slice.

BioWare, the esteemed Canadian developer founded 30+ years ago, is shutting down. The studio employed fewer than 100 people, Bloomberg reported, and the team was working on the next Mass Effect. That game is now canceled.
"BioWare is a legendary studio that helped define the role-playing genre, and we do not take this decision lightly," EA said.
